chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The one performing tamattu' circles the House and performs sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah so long as he catches up with the people at Mina.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: caught up with or reached in time
key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two stations of sa'y
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other station of sa'y
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina during the hajj rites

ai.seo_question: Until what time can a pilgrim still attain tamattu' in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the time in which a person may still attain tamattu' in hajj. It indicates that one performing tamattu' may do tawaf of the House and sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah as long as he reaches the people at Mina.
